description_en: Unbinds a license from a specific product
description_zh: 调用该接口取消指定产品的License授权
kebab_example: aliyun iot unbind-license-product --iot-instance-id iot-s3000 --license-code 480P --product-key gq62z000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindLicenseProduct

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
parameters.description_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The license type that specifies the audio and video specifications. Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

To view the license type of a product, choose **License Management > Product Authorization** in the **Real-time Communication Service** console.
parameters.description_zh:
License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的License类型。

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product from which you want to unbind the license.

You can choose **License Management > Product Authorization** in the **Real-Time Communication Service** console to view the **ProductKey** of the product.

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的**Product Key**。
